title: Cohomology vanishes above the dimension of the support
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme] (quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]), let $\mathcal F$ be an abelian sheaf on the underlying topological space of $X$, and suppose that the support $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)=\{x\in X:\mathcal F_x\neq0\}$ (stalks as in [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]) is contained in a closed subset $Z\subseteq X$ of topological Krull dimension at most $r$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], where $r\geq0$ is an integer. Then $H^p(X,\mathcal F)=0$ for every integer $p>r$, with cohomology as in [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology].
